description: This file defines a Perl package 'Coocook::Schema' which extends DBIx::Class::Schema::Config. It provides database schema configuration, including custom connection handling, statistics gathering, and database-specific methods for PostgreSQL and SQLite. It also loads components and namespaces relevant to the application's database layer.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema
classes.description: A schema class for the Coocook application, extending DBIx::Class::Schema::Config, providing custom connection handling, statistics, and database-specific methods.

methods.name: connection
methods.description: Overrides the default connection method to set default connection options, especially enabling foreign key constraints in SQLite.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of records across specified resultsets or all sources if none specified.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Returns a hashref with counts and sums for various entities like dishes, recipes, projects, users, and organizations.

methods.name: pgsql_set_constraints_deferred
methods.description: Issues a command to defer constraints in PostgreSQL if connected to a PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: fk_checks_off_do
methods.description: Temporarily disables foreign key checks in SQLite, runs a provided coderef, then restores the original foreign key setting.

methods.name: enable_fk_checks
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: disable_fk_checks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in SQLite.

methods.name: sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets SQLite PRAGMA values, specifically used here for foreign key constraints.
